title: 第15章 意外之喜当众质问第16章 阴阳二老秋岚狩猎
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 若换做其他场合，他们自然懒得搭理，可眼下父皇看着，怎敢生出逆反心理，只得起身一个个表示。
谁让他们是皇兄，谁让他们在大虞中享福，谁让孟尘在敌国中受罪呢……
身为皇兄，他们接风宴上出手表示，这些事迹若是传出去，对外人来说也算是皇族宫中的一段美事佳话吧！
大皇子送的赤金甲胄。
二皇子送的玉净瓶灵液。
三皇子送的是一株万年雪莲。
四皇子送的是一头六阶境界的黑烈虎。
五皇子则送了一对日月羊脂玉手镯。
“如此破费，多谢几位皇兄了！”
孟尘没有假装推脱，尽数收下。
这些东西，对他来说虽无用，但也都是好东西，留给身边的人也好。
至少这一趟，人没白来。
“这几个孩子很用心思，朕很是欣慰！”
“都坐下吧，日后有的是时间相聚！”
虞皇满脸笑意，同时让玉妃，皇后等人皆回到自己的位置上，举杯共饮。
孟尘这里，则以茶代酒。
同时，也顺便见过了镇国王府的几位长辈。
对于孟尘这里，几个老家伙都很满意。
至少，孟尘这里的状态，比他们所想象的要好很多，论现在的容貌与气质，皆不输五大皇子，且看起来也不像是会常去烟雨楼那种场所之人？
最重要的是，孟尘的长相他们越看越顺眼。
说到底，孟尘都是大虞六皇子，又能差到哪里去？
相比于其他人选，六皇子对他们镇国王府来说，已经是最佳人选了。
很快，太医被请来了，直接为孟尘诊脉。
“麻烦了。”
孟尘轻语一声，伸出了手臂。
瞬间，殿内众多目光，纷纷聚集到了他的身上。
这其中，也包括镇国王府的几个老家伙。
他们对孟尘的身体状态，绝对比在场的其他人都要关心。
毕竟，有着婚事在，他们已经将孟尘视作为自己人了。
“我身体可好？”
孟尘看了太医一眼，平静问道。
“六殿下无碍。”
content_en:
If it were any other situation, they would naturally be too lazy to respond, but now that their father was looking at him, how could they dare to have a rebellious attitude, so they had to stand up and express their opinions one by one.
Who allowed them to be royal brothers, who allowed them to enjoy happiness in the Great Yu, and who made Meng Chen suffer in the enemy country...
As royal brothers, they took action at the reception banquet to express that if these deeds were spread, it would be regarded as a beautiful story in the royal palace to outsiders!
The red gold armor given by the eldest prince.
A jade bottle of spiritual liquid given by the second prince.
What the third prince gave as a gift was a ten thousand year old snow lotus.
The fourth prince gave him a sixth-level black fierce tiger.
The fifth prince presented a pair of sun and moon mutton fat jade bracelets.
"Thank you so much to the royal brothers for such a waste of money!"
Meng Chen did not pretend to shirk, but accepted them all.
Although these things are useless to him, they are still good things and can be left to the people around him.
At least this trip was not in vain.
"These children are very thoughtful, I am very pleased!"
"Everyone, sit down. There will be plenty of time to get together in the future!"
With a smile on his face, Emperor Yu asked Concubine Yu, the Queen and others to return to their seats and raise their glasses to drink together.
Meng Chen here replaces wine with tea.
At the same time, I also met several elders from the Zhenwang Mansion.
Several old guys are very satisfied with Meng Chen.
At least, Meng Chen's condition here is much better than they imagined. In terms of current appearance and temperament, he is not inferior to the five princes, and he doesn't look like someone who often goes to places like Yanyu Tower?
The most important thing is that the more they look at Meng Chen's appearance, the more they like it.
After all, Meng Chen is the sixth prince of Dayu, so how can he be so different?
Compared with other candidates, the Sixth Prince is already the best candidate for their palace.
Soon, the imperial doctor was invited to directly diagnose Meng Chen's pulse.
"Trouble."
Meng Chen whispered and stretched out his arm.
In an instant, many eyes in the hall focused on him.
Among them, there are also a few old guys from Zhenwang Mansion.
They were definitely more concerned about Meng Chen's physical condition than anyone else present.
After all, with the marriage pending, they already regarded Meng Chen as one of their own.
"How am I feeling?"
Meng Chen glanced at the imperial doctor and asked calmly.
"Your Majesty, Sixth Prince, you are fine."
